summary: All 4 polish items VERIFIED on Iron Forge skin as ryan@ryan.com. (1) Dashboard cold-start fonts: every numeric stat tile (15 / $3323.00 / 1 / 1) and label (TOTAL ITEMS / NET WORTH / CHECKED OUT / OPEN CLAIMS / MAINTENANCE DUE) renders in BebasNeue_400Regular on the very first paint after login — the new useTbvFonts + 1-frame warmer gate in app/_layout.tsx ShellNav() is working. Confirmed via getComputedStyle on the leaf Text nodes: fontFamily = 'BebasNeue_400Regular' across the board (no Times New Roman / system fallback). (2) Inventory summary accordion on Iron Forge: tapping summary-accordion-toggle expands the panel and the stats row (15 Items / $3323.00 Total / 1 Out / 1 Repair / 1 Claims) plus the Locations / Categories / Dealers columns render FLAT directly on the metal search panel. SummaryHeader testID confirms self computed style: backgroundColor=rgba(0,0,0,0), borderRadius=0, boxShadow=none, margin=0, padding=0; the wrapping searchSummaryInset only adds a 1px borderTop divider with no shadow / no rounded card. No separate gray rounded card or drop-shadow box behind the content (screenshot /tmp/inv_summary_open.png). (3) Item Details tab strip now has 7 tabs in the exact requested order: tab-details, tab-bundle, tab-photos, tab-documents, tab-maintenance, tab-warranty, tab-history (verified via DOM scan). Photos is its OWN tab: it shows the 'PHOTOS (n)' section header, add-photo-btn ADD pill, and the horizontal gallery-thumb-0..n strip (screenshot /tmp/tab_photos.png). Documents tab no longer contains photos — only the DOCUMENTS and RECEIPTS sections render; add-photo-btn is NOT present and no gallery-thumb-* nodes exist on that tab (screenshot /tmp/tab_documents.png). (4) Tab strip styling on Iron Forge: every tab's icon+label is WHITE (rgb(255,255,255)) when not selected and turns ORANGE accent (rgb(255,106,0)) when selected; ALL seven tabs have backgroundColor=rgba(0,0,0,0), borderRadius=0, boxShadow=none — i.e. NO filled rounded pill background behind the selected tab. Captured two active-tab screenshots to confirm: Details active (/tmp/detail_init.png) and Bundle active (/tmp/tab_bundle_active.png) plus a Warranty active capture (/tmp/tab_warranty_active.png). Regression: History tab opens the compact menu-style popup (history-choice-checkout / history-choice-claims visible — /tmp/tab_history_popup.png); inline CHECKOUTS / CLAIMS segmented toggle still renders in the bounded panel below. Bundle ADD TO A BUNDLE button (bundle-add) is the themed metal plate button after the ~4 s industrial skin asset decode window. Warranty tab is its own tab with 'WARRANTY' + 'No warranty information available.' + ADD WARRANTY INFORMATION (screenshot /tmp/tab_warranty.png). 3-dot menu opens via testID tool-menu-btn (note: header trigger testID is tool-menu-btn, NOT header-menu — already validated in prior iterations). No pageerror, no React Native red screen, no new console errors.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab strip now has 7 tabs (testIDs tab-details, tab-bundle, tab-photos, tab-documents, tab-maintenance, tab-warranty, tab-history). Photos tab owns add-photo-btn and gallery-thumb-* — Documents tab no longer renders any photo gallery. Iron Forge tab styling: inactive = white text+icon, active = orange (theme.colors.accent = rgb(255,106,0)), backgroundColor transparent on ALL tabs with no borderRadius and no boxShadow (no pill). The 3-dot trigger on the tool detail header is data-testid='tool-menu-btn' (not 'header-menu'); after opening, menu-edit / menu-share / etc. become visible.
